import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

    # Inspect schemas (for clarity, not mandatory)
    # print(df_source0.columns)
    # print(df_source1.columns)

    # Transformation plan:
    # - Source0 has ['PLAYER', '2017-18']
    # - Source1 has all other stats keyed by 'Player'
    # - Join Source0 and Source1 on Source0.PLAYER == Source1.Player
    # - After join, rename and reorder columns to match target schema:
    #   Target schema:
    #   ['PLAYER': string, '2017-18': integer, '#': integer, 'Player': string, 'Team': string, 'GP': integer,
    #    'MPG': float, 'FGM': float, 'FGA': float, 'FG%': float, '3PM': float, '3PA': float, '3P%': float,
    #    'FTM': float, 'FTA': float, 'FT%': float, 'TOV': float, 'PF': float, 'ORB': float, 'DRB': float,
    #    'RPG': float, 'APG': float, 'SPG': float, 'BPG': float, 'PPG': float]

    # Join on PLAYER == Player
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, left_on='PLAYER', right_on='Player', how='inner')

    # Ensure correct dtypes:
    # '2017-18' should be integer
    df_merged['2017-18'] = df_merged['2017-18'].astype(int)

    # 'GP' should be integer
    df_merged['GP'] = df_merged['GP'].astype(int)

    # '#' should be integer
    df_merged['#'] = df_merged['#'].astype(int)

    # Other numeric columns to float
    float_cols = ['MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%',
                  'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']
    for col in float_cols:
        df_merged[col] = df_merged[col].astype(float)

    # Reorder columns to target schema order
    target_columns = ['PLAYER', '2017-18', '#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%',
                      '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG',
                      'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']

    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Save to target path
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
